title: STARLINC: Satellite Trail Artifact Removal using Inter-Frame Correlation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29145v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid expansion of low Earth orbit satellites such as Starlink is increasingly contaminating astronomical surveys. In practice, contaminated images are often identified through inspection. However, modern surveys generate terabytes of data each night, making manual screening infeasible and necessitating reliable automated methods for satellite trail removal. Unfortunately, existing general-domain line detection methods fail to generalize to astronomical images due to domain mismatch, which are mostly grayscale with sparse bright stars and have a low signal-to-noise ratio. Moreover, training new models from scratch is impractical due to the lack of large-scale annotated astronomical datasets. To address these challenges, we introduce STARLINC, the first ML-based framework for satellite trail removal without requiring tedious pixel-level annotation of astronomical images. translated_title: STARLINC：利用帧间相关性去除卫星轨迹伪影
translated_abstract: 诸如Starlink等近地轨道卫星的快速扩张正日益污染天文巡天观测数据。在实际工作中，受污染的图像通常通过人工检查来识别。然而，现代巡天项目每晚都会产生数TB的数据，使得人工筛选变得不可行，因此迫切需要可靠的卫星轨迹自动化去除方法。遗憾的是，现有的通用领域线段检测方法由于领域不匹配而难以推广到天文图像——天文图像大多为灰度图、亮星稀疏且信噪比低。此外，由于缺乏大规模标注的天文数据集，从头训练新模型也不切实际。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了STARLINC，这是首个无需繁琐的天文图像像素级标注即可实现卫星轨迹去除的机器学习框架。STARLINC结合了用于训练的合成卫星轨迹生成（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了首个无需像素级标注的机器学习框架STARLINC，利用帧间相关性与合成卫星轨迹生成技术，解决天文图像中卫星轨迹污染的自动去除难题。
en_tdlr: STARLINC is the first ML-based framework for removing satellite trail artifacts from astronomical images without requiring pixel-level annotations, leveraging inter-frame correlation and synthetic trail generation to overcome domain mismatch and data scarcity.
